scientific_findings: VTLN_TRANSFER_IMPROVEMENT: Integrating VTLN formant warping with dual-stream cross-attention improved zero-shot Pearson correlation on SpeechOcean762 from 0.1610 (HTC-Net) to 0.2110 (DAMH-Net), mitigating adolescent/child vocal tract length shift.
STANDALONE_CHAMPIONS: DSCA-Net (EXP-55) remains the primary standalone champion on L2-ARCTIC (Utility=0.4928), and Duodecim-Pareto (EXP-58) remains the ensemble champion (Macro AP=0.6341).
